engineering_notes: CUSTOM PCB EXTERNAL PDOA OFFSET; not a final Murata parameter.
LUT input = CUSTOM_PDOA_SIGN * (unwrapped PDoA - zero offset). Preserve the calibrated branch; do not extrapolate in deployment.
Reversed orientation: consider swapping logical ANT1/ANT2 or inverting the coordinate-transform PDoA sign; no firmware settings were changed.
